description: This file is a PHP source code for testing and managing test plans within the TestLink open-source testing platform. It includes session management, request handling, user authorization, and functions for initializing arguments, launching embedded pages, and processing test execution-related actions.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class handling test plan data, with methods like get_by_id().

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Class managing hierarchical test structure, providing methods like get_node_hierarchy_info() and get_path().

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class managing test project data, including session project setting.

methods.name: checkConfiguration
methods.description: Checks and verifies system configuration before proceeding.

methods.name: testlinkInitPage
methods.description: Initializes page setup for TestLink environment.

methods.name: lang_get
methods.description: Retrieves localized strings based on a key.

methods.name: checkTestPlan
methods.description: Verifies user rights and test plan existence.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and validates request parameters for test actions.

methods.name: build_link_exec
methods.description: Constructs URL query string for execution links based on arguments.

methods.name: process_exec
methods.description: Processes execution of a test case, returning URL and message.

methods.name: process_xta2m
methods.description: Processes 'eXecution Tasks Assigned To Me' actions, returning URL and message.

methods.name: check_exec
methods.description: Checks and retrieves details required for execution, updating args.

methods.name: check_xta2m
methods.description: Validates 'eXecution Tasks Assigned To Me' request parameters.

methods.name: launch_inner_exec
methods.description: Handles the internal page for executing specific test actions.

methods.name: launch_inner_xta2m
methods.description: Handles the internal page for 'Tasks Assigned To Me' view.

methods.name: launch_outer_exec
methods.description: Generates the outer frame page for execution views.

methods.name: launch_outer_xta2m
methods.description: Generates the outer frame page for 'Tasks Assigned To Me' views.

methods.name: buildCookie
methods.description: Builds a cookie info structure based on test structure hierarchy.
